concept: A blanket-warm evening sanctuary that treats staying home and restorative rest as something complete.
floor: One broad continuous plush carpet across the full top face in muted dusk blue, with a smooth softly beveled surface and no fibers, seams, border, medallion, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One compact open-front sleep nook at the rear with a broad pillow-shaped canopy, a simple tucked bed, and one warm amber window.
side_props: one chunky cushioned armchair with a draped blanket on the upper-left edge
two oversized pillow-shaped shrubs and one simple moon lamp on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth quilted-looking border made from broad upholstered masses, without tiny stitching

materials: a few broad plum timber blocks

lighting: soft evening-blue ambient light with three broad pools of warm amber sanctuary glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open carpet
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny stitching, fabric fibers, stars, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
